title: Jesus... He Ended Three Years With One Text
topic: boyfriend ended a three year relationship over text

bible.text: The LORD is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... he ended three years with one text. "I think we want different things." That's it. 💔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I keep reading it, like if I read it enough it'll say something else.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Put the phone down for a minute. Look at Me instead.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Was I that easy to leave?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: How he left says something about him. It doesn't decide what you're worth.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Then why do I feel like nothing right now?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Because three years don't disappear in one night. The pain is real. So am I, right here, while it hurts.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You won't feel like this forever. Tonight, just let Me stay with you.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to someone who's reading an old message again tonight. 💔
